18137    /// F7 (adjacent-snapshot sensitivity): this fixture directly places two
18138    /// admissions in adjacent step2 drains; it does not model a production
18139    /// handler protocol. Every current asynchronous admission site separately
18140    /// fixes snapshot membership: ordinary clone buffers before the parent's
18141    /// `ParentContinue`, `vfork` uses its registration barrier, and exec
18142    /// reconnect buffers before retiring and resolving the caller request. See
18143    /// [`Scheduler::admit_to_run_queue`] for those causal bindings.
18144    ///
18145    /// The synthetic split remains a negative/sensitivity bracket for that
18146    /// requirement. Replaying one fixed split at one seed is reproducible, but
18147    /// swapping which child occupies the first drain changes the resolved queue
18148    /// order. Thus a future unanchored admission site would make host-selected
18149    /// membership observable; this test must not be read as evidence that any
18150    /// current production site is unanchored.
18151    #[test]
18152    fn deferred_admission_binds_to_snapshot_membership_across_adjacent_drains() {
18153        let config = Config {
18154            sched_seed: Some(0x5107),
18155            runs_post_fork: RunsPostFork::Random,
18156            ..Default::default()
18157        };
18158        let anchor = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18159        let a = DetTid::from_raw(31);
18160        let b = DetTid::from_raw(37);
18161
18162        // Admit `first` in drain 1 and `second` in drain 2 (two adjacent step2
18163        // drains) and return the final run-queue order relative to a fixed
18164        // anchor, which encodes each child's resolved front/back side.
18165        let split = |first: DetTid, second: DetTid| -> Vec<DetTid> {
18166            let mut sched = Scheduler::new(&config);
18167            register_known_thread(&mut sched, anchor);
18168            register_known_thread(&mut sched, a);
18169            register_known_thread(&mut sched, b);
18170            sched.runqueue_push_back(anchor);
18171
18172            sched.admit_to_run_queue(first, AdmitIntent::PostFork(RunsPostFork::Random));
18173            sched.drain_pending_run_queue_admissions(); // drain 1
18174            sched.admit_to_run_queue(second, AdmitIntent::PostFork(RunsPostFork::Random));
18175            sched.drain_pending_run_queue_admissions(); // drain 2 (adjacent)
18176
18177            sched.run_queue.tids().copied().collect()
18178        };
18179
18180        // Fixed synthetic membership is deterministic across identical replays.
18181        let canonical = split(a, b);
18182        assert_eq!(
18183            canonical,
18184            split(a, b),
18185            "identical schedule -> identical result"
18186        );
18187        assert!(canonical.contains(&a) && canonical.contains(&b) && canonical.contains(&anchor));
18188
18189        // Sensitivity control: changing synthetic snapshot membership changes
18190        // the outcome for this seed, so a missing production anchor would be
18191        // observable rather than inert.
18192        assert_ne!(
18193            split(a, b),
18194            split(b, a),
18195            "swapping snapshot membership changes the resolved order"
18196        );
18197    }

18199    #[test]
18200    fn vfork_registration_barrier_blocks_until_child_registration() {
18201        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18202        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18203        let child = DetTid::from_raw(5);
18204        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, None);
18205
18206        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18207        scheduler.complete_vfork_registration(parent, child);
18208        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_ok());
18209        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&Some(child)));
18210    }

18212    /// While a vfork barrier stands, a queued child that will run its turn is
18213    /// selected before other runnable threads; a child that is only polling a
18214    /// call that is not ready, or not queued at all, lets them run, as when it
18215    /// waits for a sibling's write (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4194);
18216    /// a backgrounded child, whose call the host times, is waited for (Claude
18217    /// review of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4205).
18218    #[test]
18219    fn a_vfork_barrier_selects_its_child_only_while_it_will_run_a_turn() {
18220        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18221        let child = DetTid::from_raw(5);
18222        let other = DetTid::from_raw(7);
18223        let fresh = || {
18224            let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18225            for tid in [parent, child, other] {
18226                scheduler.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18227                scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18228                    tid,
18229                    ThreadNextTurn {
18230                        dettid: tid,
18231                        child_tid_addr: 0,
18232                        req: Ivar::full(Ok(Resources::new(tid))),
18233                        resp: Ivar::new(),
18234                        protocol: Default::default(),
18235                    },
18236                );
18237            }
18238            scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18239            scheduler
18240        };
18241        let selected = |scheduler: &mut Scheduler| {
18242            let (tid, _, _) = scheduler.step3_peek().expect("a thread is runnable");
18243            scheduler.run_queue.undo_tentative_pop();
18244            tid
18245        };
18246
18247        // The child is queued behind the other thread and still runs first.
18248        let mut queued = fresh();
18249        queued.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18250        queued.run_queue.push_back(child, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18251        assert_eq!(selected(&mut queued), child);
18252
18253        // A runnable child in the last priority band, where
18254        // `--chaos-target-races` can put it, is not polling and still runs
18255        // first (Claude re-check of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4205).
18256        let mut last_band = fresh();
18257        last_band.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18258        last_band
18259            .run_queue
18260            .push_back(child, runqueue::LAST_PRIORITY);
18261        assert_eq!(selected(&mut last_band), child);
18262
18263        // A polling child lets the other thread run, ahead of it in priority.
18264        let mut polling = fresh();
18265        polling
18266            .run_queue
18267            .push_poller(child, DEFAULT_PRIORITY, u32::MAX);
18268        polling.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18269        assert_eq!(selected(&mut polling), other);
18270
18271        // A child that is not queued lets the other thread run.
18272        let mut blocked = fresh();
18273        blocked.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18274        assert_eq!(selected(&mut blocked), other);
18275        assert_eq!(blocked.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&Some(child)));
18276
18277        // A backgrounded child, whose call the host times, is waited for:
18278        // nothing is selected until step 2c readmits it.
18279        let mut backgrounded = fresh();
18280        backgrounded.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18281        backgrounded
18282            .blocked
18283            .external_io_blockers
18284            .insert(child, ExternalOpId::new(child, 1));
18285        assert!(backgrounded.step3_peek().is_none());
18286        assert_eq!(backgrounded.vfork_gated_background_child(), Some(child));
18287    }

18289    /// A vfork parent killed while its registered child's barrier is up takes
18290    /// the barrier with it (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3984).
18291    /// While the barrier stands and its child is not queued, another runnable
18292    /// thread is selected, as when the child waits for it
18293    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4194); before that change,
18294    /// `step3_peek` selected nobody here.
18295    #[test]
18296    fn a_killed_vfork_parent_takes_its_barrier_with_it() {
18297        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18298        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18299        let child = DetTid::from_raw(5);
18300        let other = DetTid::from_raw(7);
18301        for tid in [parent, other] {
18302            scheduler.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18303            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18304                tid,
18305                ThreadNextTurn {
18306                    dettid: tid,
18307                    child_tid_addr: 0,
18308                    req: Ivar::full(Ok(Resources::new(tid))),
18309                    resp: Ivar::new(),
18310                    protocol: Default::default(),
18311                },
18312            );
18313        }
18314        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18315        scheduler.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18316        let (selected, _, _) = scheduler
18317            .step3_peek()
18318            .expect("with the child not queued, the other thread runs");
18319        assert_eq!(selected, other);
18320        scheduler.run_queue.undo_tentative_pop();
18321        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&Some(child)));
18322
18323        scheduler.thread_tree.add_child(parent, parent, true);
18324        scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&parent, &parent, MmId::initial(parent));
18325        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18326        assert!(!scheduler.dead_vfork_parents.contains(&parent));
18327        let (selected, _, _) = scheduler.step3_peek().expect("the other thread runs");
18328        assert_eq!(selected, other);
18329        scheduler.run_queue.undo_tentative_pop();
18330    }

18332    /// A vfork parent killed while its registered child can still run keeps
18333    /// its barrier, marked parent-dead, so the next selection is the child's
18334    /// whether the parent's retirement arrives before or after the child's
18335    /// turn. The child's next release edge (here its logical kill) drops the
18336    /// barrier, and only then can another thread be selected
18337    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3984).
18338    #[test]
18339    fn a_killed_vfork_parents_barrier_lasts_until_its_childs_release_edge() {
18340        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18341        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18342        let child = DetTid::from_raw(5);
18343        let other = DetTid::from_raw(7);
18344        for tid in [parent, child, other] {
18345            scheduler.thread_tree.add_child(tid, tid, true);
18346            scheduler.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18347            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18348                tid,
18349                ThreadNextTurn {
18350                    dettid: tid,
18351                    child_tid_addr: 0,
18352                    req: Ivar::full(Ok(Resources::new(tid))),
18353                    resp: Ivar::new(),
18354                    protocol: Default::default(),
18355                },
18356            );
18357        }
18358        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18359        scheduler.run_queue.push_back(other, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18360        scheduler.run_queue.push_back(child, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18361
18362        scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&parent, &parent, MmId::initial(parent));
18363        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&Some(child)));
18364        let (selected, _, _) = scheduler.step3_peek().expect("the child runs");
18365        assert_eq!(selected, child, "not the bystander queued first");
18366        scheduler.run_queue.undo_tentative_pop();
18367
18368        scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&child, &child, MmId::initial(child));
18369        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18370        assert!(scheduler.dead_parent_vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18371        scheduler.step2_drain_prefix().unwrap();
18372        let (selected, _, _) = scheduler.step3_peek().expect("the bystander runs");
18373        assert_eq!(selected, other);
18374        scheduler.run_queue.undo_tentative_pop();
18375    }

18377    /// The child's `Exit` grant is a release edge: inside that committed turn

18380    fn a_vfork_childs_exit_grant_releases_its_dead_parents_barrier() {

18401

18422    /// A scheduler with vfork parent 3 and its registered child 5, both alive,

18433                ThreadNextTurn {
18434                    dettid: tid,
18435                    child_tid_addr: 0,
18436                    req: Ivar::full(Ok(Resources::new(tid))),
18437                    resp: Ivar::new(),
18438                    protocol: Default::default(),
18439                },
18440            );
18441        }
18442        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18443        (scheduler, parent, child)
18444    }

18446    /// The child's successful exec is a release edge even while its parent is
18447    /// alive: step2a then waits, committing nothing, until the parent's fate is
18448    /// known. Here the parent's retirement arrives after the exec edge, the
18449    /// order in which the barrier used to outlive the exec; it drops the
18450    /// barrier, exactly as a retirement before the edge does
18451    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3984).
18452    #[test]
18453    fn a_vfork_parent_retired_after_its_childs_exec_releases_the_barrier() {
18454        let (mut scheduler, parent, child) = live_vfork_pair();
18455        scheduler.record_successful_exec(child);
18456        assert!(scheduler.released_vfork_barriers.contains(&parent));
18457        assert!(
18458            scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err(),
18459            "waits for the parent's fate"
18460        );
18461
18462        scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&parent, &parent, MmId::initial(parent));
18463        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18464        assert!(scheduler.released_vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18465        assert!(scheduler.dead_parent_vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18466        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_ok());
18467    }
18468
18469    /// After the child's exec edge, the live parent's continuation ends the
18470    /// released barrier.
18471    #[test]
18472    fn a_released_vfork_barrier_ends_at_the_parents_continuation() {
18473        let (mut scheduler, parent, child) = live_vfork_pair();
18474        scheduler.record_successful_exec(child);
18475        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18476
18477        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(parent, 7);
18478        let mut continuation = Resources::new(parent);
18479        continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
18480        scheduler.next_turns.get_mut(&parent).unwrap().req = Ivar::full(Ok(continuation));
18481        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_ok());
18482        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18483        assert!(scheduler.released_vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18484    }

18486    /// Backdates the start of step2a's wait past its valve: an injected clock,
18487    /// so the production bound needs no test knob.
18488    fn expire_vfork_barrier_valve(scheduler: &mut Scheduler) {
18489        scheduler.vfork_barrier_wait_since = Some(
18490            std::time::Instant::now()
18491                .checked_sub(Scheduler::VFORK_BARRIER_VALVE + Duration::from_secs(1))
18492                .expect("the monotonic clock has run longer than the valve"),
18493        );
18494    }

18496    /// A vfork child that vforks again is backgrounded in its own `vfork`
18497    /// while its child, queued, cannot be selected behind the outer barrier.
18498    /// Step 2c must name that backgrounded child for readmission instead of
18499    /// deferring to the queued work forever
18500    /// (<https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4163>).
18501    #[test]
18502    fn a_backgrounded_vfork_child_is_named_when_the_gate_excludes_queued_work() {
18503        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(7);
18504        let child = DetTid::from_raw(25);
18505        let grandchild = DetTid::from_raw(27);
18506        let queue = |scheduler: &mut Scheduler, tid: DetTid| {
18507            scheduler.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18508            scheduler.runqueue_push_back(tid);
18509        };
18510
18511        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18512        // No barrier: nothing is gated.
18513        queue(&mut scheduler, grandchild);
18514        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_gated_background_child(), None);
18515
18516        // The outer barrier's child is backgrounded and the grandchild queued.
18517        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18518        scheduler
18519            .blocked
18520            .external_io_blockers
18521            .insert(child, ExternalOpId::new(child, 1));
18522        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_gated_background_child(), Some(child));
18523
18524        // Once the child is queued, step 3 can select it: nothing to readmit.
18525        queue(&mut scheduler, child);
18526        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_gated_background_child(), None);
18527
18528        // A barrier child that is neither queued nor backgrounded is not named.
18529        let mut blocked_elsewhere = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18530        blocked_elsewhere.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18531        queue(&mut blocked_elsewhere, grandchild);
18532        assert_eq!(blocked_elsewhere.vfork_gated_background_child(), None);
18533
18534        // With two gated barriers the first in parent order is named, however
18535        // the blockers were inserted, as step 3 selects in that order.
18536        let mut two = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18537        let (low, low_child) = (DetTid::from_raw(3), DetTid::from_raw(5));
18538        let (high, high_child) = (DetTid::from_raw(9), DetTid::from_raw(11));
18539        two.vfork_barriers.insert(high, Some(high_child));
18540        two.vfork_barriers.insert(low, Some(low_child));
18541        two.blocked
18542            .external_io_blockers
18543            .insert(high_child, ExternalOpId::new(high_child, 1));
18544        two.blocked
18545            .external_io_blockers
18546            .insert(low_child, ExternalOpId::new(low_child, 1));
18547        queue(&mut two, grandchild);
18548        assert_eq!(two.vfork_gated_background_child(), Some(low_child));
18549
18550        // Three levels: P vforks C, C vforks G, G's child has execed. C, still
18551        // inside its own vfork, cannot finish before G, so the innermost
18552        // backgrounded child, G, is named although C's barrier comes first.
18553        let mut three = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18554        let great_grandchild = DetTid::from_raw(29);
18555        three.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18556        three.vfork_barriers.insert(child, Some(grandchild));
18557        for backgrounded in [child, grandchild] {
18558            three
18559                .blocked
18560                .external_io_blockers
18561                .insert(backgrounded, ExternalOpId::new(backgrounded, 1));
18562        }
18563        queue(&mut three, great_grandchild);
18564        assert_eq!(three.vfork_gated_background_child(), Some(grandchild));
18565        // A child that holds a barrier is never named, even alone.
18566        three.blocked.external_io_blockers.remove(&grandchild);
18567        assert_eq!(three.vfork_gated_background_child(), None);
18568    }
18569
18570    /// A pending barrier whose child never registers is refused by name once
18571    /// the valve expires, and the barrier stays, so no other thread is
18572    /// selected at a moment the host chose
18573    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3999).
18574    #[test]
18575    fn a_pending_vfork_barrier_past_its_valve_refuses_the_run_and_stays() {
18576        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18577        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18578        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, None);
18579
18580        // Inside the valve, the first pass starts the clock and only waits.
18581        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18582        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_wait_since.is_some());
18583        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_refusal.is_none());
18584
18585        expire_vfork_barrier_valve(&mut scheduler);
18586        for _ in 0..2 {
18587            assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18588            assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&None));
18589        }
18590        let refusal = scheduler
18591            .vfork_barrier_refusal
18592            .take()
18593            .expect("an expired wait records a typed refusal");
18594        assert_eq!(
18595            refusal.waits,
18596            vec![VforkBarrierWait {
18597                parent,
18598                child: None,
18599                state: VforkBarrierState::Pending,
18600            }]
18601        );
18602        assert!(refusal.waited >= Scheduler::VFORK_BARRIER_VALVE);
18603        let text = refusal.to_string();
18604        assert!(text.starts_with("hermit refused to continue the run"));
18605        assert!(text.contains(
18606            "parent 3 (no child registered) Pending, awaiting the child's registration;"
18607        ));
18608    }

18610    /// A released barrier whose parent never posts its continuation, and is
18611    /// never retired, is refused by name once the valve expires, and the
18612    /// barrier stays released.
18613    #[test]
18614    fn a_released_vfork_barrier_past_its_valve_refuses_the_run_and_stays() {
18615        let (mut scheduler, parent, child) = live_vfork_pair();
18616        scheduler.record_successful_exec(child);
18617        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18618        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_refusal.is_none());
18619
18620        expire_vfork_barrier_valve(&mut scheduler);
18621        for _ in 0..2 {
18622            assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18623            assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&Some(child)));
18624            assert!(scheduler.released_vfork_barriers.contains(&parent));
18625        }
18626        let refusal = scheduler
18627            .vfork_barrier_refusal
18628            .take()
18629            .expect("an expired wait records a typed refusal");
18630        assert_eq!(
18631            refusal.waits,
18632            vec![VforkBarrierWait {
18633                parent,
18634                child: Some(child),
18635                state: VforkBarrierState::Released,
18636            }]
18637        );
18638        assert!(refusal.to_string().contains(
18639            "parent 3 (child 5) Released, awaiting the parent's continuation or retirement;"
18640        ));
18641    }

18643    /// Control: when the awaited event arrives inside the valve, the barrier
18644    /// ends as before, the clock stops and nothing is refused; a later wait
18645    /// starts its own clock rather than inheriting the earlier one.
18646    #[test]
18647    fn a_vfork_barrier_event_inside_the_valve_proceeds_and_stops_the_clock() {
18648        let (mut scheduler, parent, child) = live_vfork_pair();
18649        scheduler.record_successful_exec(child);
18650        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18651        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_wait_since.is_some());
18652
18653        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(parent, 7);
18654        let mut continuation = Resources::new(parent);
18655        continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
18656        scheduler.next_turns.get_mut(&parent).unwrap().req = Ivar::full(Ok(continuation));
18657        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_ok());
18658        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18659        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_wait_since.is_none());
18660        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_refusal.is_none());
18661
18662        // A new wait, for another parent, starts its own clock.
18663        let other_parent = DetTid::from_raw(9);
18664        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(other_parent, None);
18665        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18666        let since = scheduler
18667            .vfork_barrier_wait_since
18668            .expect("the new wait starts the clock");
18669        assert!(since.elapsed() < Scheduler::VFORK_BARRIER_VALVE);
18670        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barrier_refusal.is_none());
18671    }

18673    /// A barrier kept for a dead parent's still-running child is stale once

18743    // AUTONOMOUS-BOT-IMPLEMENTED
18744    // TODO-HUMAN-REVIEW(PR-1152): Review deferred vfork child registration.
18745    #[test]
18746    fn vfork_registration_barrier_waits_for_deferred_child_at_continuation() {
18747        // On a backend that defers the child spawn (e.g. KVM), the parent posts its continuation
18748        // BEFORE the child registers. An unfulfilled barrier at continuation must be kept, not
18749        // torn down as a failed clone; otherwise the late child panics on registration.
18750        let config = Config::default().with_backend(|backend| {
18751            backend.defers_vfork_child_registration = true;
18752        });
18753        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&config);
18754        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18755        let child = DetTid::from_raw(5);
18756        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(parent, 7);
18757        let mut continuation = Resources::new(parent);
18758        continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
18759
18760        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, None);
18761        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18762            parent,
18763            ThreadNextTurn {
18764                dettid: parent,
18765                child_tid_addr: 0,
18766                req: Ivar::full(Ok(continuation)),
18767                resp: Ivar::new(),
18768                protocol: Default::default(),
18769            },
18770        );
18771
18772        // Parent is at its continuation but the child has not registered: keep waiting, keep the
18773        // barrier (the failed-clone teardown must NOT fire on a deferring backend).
18774        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_err());
18775        assert_eq!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.get(&parent), Some(&None));
18776
18777        // The deferred child registers; now the barrier is fulfilled and released.
18778        scheduler.complete_vfork_registration(parent, child);
18779        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_ok());
18780        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18781    }

18783    // TODO-HUMAN-REVIEW(PR-1152): Review failed deferred-vfork cancellation.
18784    #[test]
18785    fn vfork_registration_barrier_releases_deferred_failed_clone() {
18786        let config = Config::default().with_backend(|backend| {
18787            backend.defers_vfork_child_registration = true;
18788        });
18789        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&config);
18790        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(3);
18791        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(parent, 7);
18792        let mut failure = Resources::new(parent);
18793        failure.insert(ResourceID::VforkFailed(op_id), Permission::RW);
18794
18795        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, None);
18796        scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.insert(parent, op_id);
18797        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18798            parent,
18799            ThreadNextTurn {
18800                dettid: parent,
18801                child_tid_addr: 0,
18802                req: Ivar::full(Ok(failure)),
18803                resp: Ivar::new(),
18804                protocol: Default::default(),
18805            },
18806        );
18807
18808        // The explicit failure proves that no deferred child is coming, so step2a cancels the
18809        // barrier instead of waiting forever. The ordinary external-continuation path can then
18810        // requeue the parent, whose syscall handler still owns and returns the original errno.
18811        assert!(scheduler.step2a_wait_for_vfork_barrier().is_ok());
18812        assert!(scheduler.vfork_barriers.is_empty());
18813        assert!(scheduler.step2c_process_io_blockers().is_ok());
18814        assert!(scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.is_empty());
18815        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(parent));
18816    }

18818    /// With two vfork barriers, a child in the last priority band that is not
18819    /// polling (P->C, Q->D: D runnable at `LAST_PRIORITY`) is the work step 3
18820    /// selects, so a finished background call of the other child C is not
18821    /// harvested between D's turns, in run or record mode: the fence and the
18822    /// deterministic-work-first gates agree (Codex re-check of
18823    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4205).
18824    #[test]
18825    fn a_runnable_last_band_vfork_child_keeps_another_childs_background_call_parked() {
18826        for recordreplay in [false, true] {
18827            let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18828            scheduler.recordreplay_modes = recordreplay;
18829            let (p, c) = (DetTid::from_raw(3), DetTid::from_raw(5));
18830            let (q, d) = (DetTid::from_raw(9), DetTid::from_raw(11));
18831            let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(c, 1);
18832            let mut continuation = Resources::new(c);
18833            continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
18834            scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(p, Some(c));
18835            scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(q, Some(d));
18836            for tid in [c, d] {
18837                scheduler.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18838            }
18839            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18840                c,
18841                ThreadNextTurn {
18842                    dettid: c,
18843                    child_tid_addr: 0,
18844                    req: Ivar::full(Ok(continuation)),
18845                    resp: Ivar::new(),
18846                    protocol: Default::default(),
18847                },
18848            );
18849            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18850                d,
18851                ThreadNextTurn {
18852                    dettid: d,
18853                    child_tid_addr: 0,
18854                    req: Ivar::full(Ok(Resources::new(d))),
18855                    resp: Ivar::new(),
18856                    protocol: Default::default(),
18857                },
18858            );
18859            scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.insert(c, op_id);
18860            scheduler.run_queue.push_back(d, runqueue::LAST_PRIORITY);
18861            assert!(
18862                !scheduler.run_queue.only_pollers(),
18863                "the band alone no longer reads as a poller \
18864                 (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4234)"
18865            );
18866
18867            assert!(scheduler.step2c_process_io_blockers().is_ok());
18868            assert_eq!(
18869                scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.get(&c),
18870                Some(&op_id),
18871                "record/replay {recordreplay}: the finished call stays parked while D runs"
18872            );
18873            let (selected, _, _) = scheduler.step3_peek().expect("D runs");
18874            assert_eq!(selected, d, "record/replay {recordreplay}");
18875            scheduler.run_queue.undo_tentative_pop();
18876        }
18877    }
18878
18879    /// A deferred SIGCHLD is not admitted while a vfork barrier's child in the
18880    /// last priority band is runnable: step 2e's gate counts it as work, as
18881    /// step 3's fence does, so the signal's commit point does not depend on
18882    /// when the host delivered it (Claude re-check of
18883    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4205).
18884    #[test]
18885    fn a_deferred_sigchld_waits_while_a_last_band_vfork_child_is_runnable() {
18886        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18887        let (parent, child) = (DetTid::from_raw(3), DetTid::from_raw(5));
18888        let waiter = DetTid::from_raw(13);
18889        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child));
18890        scheduler.priorities.insert(child, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18891        scheduler
18892            .run_queue
18893            .push_back(child, runqueue::LAST_PRIORITY);
18894        assert!(
18895            !scheduler.run_queue.only_pollers(),
18896            "the band alone no longer reads as a poller \
18897             (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4234)"
18898        );
18899        scheduler.blocked.sigchld_deferred.insert(waiter);
18900
18901        scheduler.step2e_process_signal_deferred();
18902        assert!(scheduler.blocked.sigchld_deferred.contains(&waiter));
18903        assert!(!scheduler.blocked.sigchld_ready.contains(&waiter));
18904        assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(waiter));
18905
18906        // With the child gone, no work is queued and the signal is admitted.
18907        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.remove_tid(child));
18908        scheduler.step2e_process_signal_deferred();
18909        assert!(scheduler.blocked.sigchld_ready.contains(&waiter));
18910    }
18911
18912    /// In run mode, neither a finished background call nor a deferred SIGCHLD
18913    /// is admitted while an ordinary thread in the last priority band is
18914    /// runnable, as at any other priority; with only a backed-off poller queued
18915    /// both are (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4234). Before, the
18916    /// band alone counted as a poller, so the turn of the admission depended on
18917    /// when the host finished the call or delivered the signal.
18918    #[test]
18919    fn run_mode_admits_nothing_host_timed_while_a_last_band_thread_is_runnable() {
18920        let worker = DetTid::from_raw(9);
18921        let poller = DetTid::from_raw(11);
18922        let waiter = DetTid::from_raw(13);
18923        let client = DetTid::from_raw(21);
18924        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(client, 3);
18925        let make = |queued: &[(DetTid, bool)]| {
18926            let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
18927            scheduler.priorities.insert(client, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18928            scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.insert(client, op_id);
18929            let mut continuation = Resources::new(client);
18930            continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
18931            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
18932                client,
18933                ThreadNextTurn {
18934                    dettid: client,
18935                    child_tid_addr: 0,
18936                    req: Ivar::full(Ok(continuation)),
18937                    resp: Ivar::new(),
18938                    protocol: Default::default(),
18939                },
18940            );
18941            for (tid, polls) in queued {
18942                scheduler.priorities.insert(*tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
18943                if *polls {
18944                    scheduler
18945                        .run_queue
18946                        .push_poller(*tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY, u32::MAX);
18947                } else {
18948                    scheduler.run_queue.push_back(*tid, runqueue::LAST_PRIORITY);
18949                }
18950            }
18951            scheduler.blocked.sigchld_deferred.insert(waiter);
18952            scheduler
18953        };
18954
18955        let mut busy = make(&[(worker, false)]);
18956        assert!(busy.step2c_process_io_blockers().is_ok());
18957        assert!(busy.blocked.external_io_blockers.contains_key(&client));
18958        busy.step2e_process_signal_deferred();
18959        assert!(busy.blocked.sigchld_deferred.contains(&waiter));
18960
18961        let mut polling = make(&[(poller, true)]);
18962        assert!(polling.step2c_process_io_blockers().is_ok());
18963        assert!(!polling.blocked.external_io_blockers.contains_key(&client));
18964        assert!(polling.run_queue.contains_tid(client));
18965    }

19043    /// A record/replay scheduler with `client` backgrounded on call `op_id`,
19044    /// finished when `finished`, and the poller `server`, if any, queued.
19045    fn rejoin_fixture(op_id: ExternalOpId, server: Option<DetTid>, finished: bool) -> Scheduler {
19046        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
19047        scheduler.recordreplay_modes = true;
19048        let client = op_id.tid;
19049        scheduler.priorities.insert(client, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19050        if let Some(server) = server {
19051            scheduler.priorities.insert(server, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19052            scheduler
19053                .run_queue
19054                .push_poller(server, DEFAULT_PRIORITY, u32::MAX);
19055        }
19056        scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.insert(client, op_id);
19057        let mut continuation = Resources::new(client);
19058        continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
19059        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
19060            client,
19061            ThreadNextTurn {
19062                dettid: client,
19063                child_tid_addr: 0,
19064                req: if finished {
19065                    Ivar::full(Ok(continuation))
19066                } else {
19067                    Ivar::new()
19068                },
19069                resp: Ivar::new(),
19070                protocol: Default::default(),
19071            },
19072        );
19073        scheduler
19074    }

19102    /// Queue `tid` as an ordinary (non-polling) thread with no request posted.
19103    fn queue_worker(scheduler: &mut Scheduler, tid: DetTid) {

19113            },
19114        );
19115        scheduler.runqueue_push_back(tid);

19119    fn background(scheduler: &mut Scheduler, op_id: ExternalOpId, finished: bool) {

19125        scheduler.next_turns.insert(

19300    fn fence_queue(scheduler: &mut Scheduler, tid: DetTid, poller: bool) {
19301        scheduler.priorities.insert(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19302        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
19303            tid,
19304            ThreadNextTurn {
19305                dettid: tid,
19306                child_tid_addr: 0,
19307                req: Ivar::new(),
19308                resp: Ivar::new(),
19309                protocol: Default::default(),
19310            },
19311        );
19312        if poller {
19313            scheduler
19314                .run_queue
19315                .push_poller(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY, u32::MAX);
19316        } else {
19317            scheduler.runqueue_push_back(tid);
19318        }
19319    }
19320
19321    fn fence_sleepers(scheduler: &mut Scheduler) -> Arc<Mutex<GlobalTime>> {
19322        let config = Config::default();
19323        let global_time = Arc::new(Mutex::new(GlobalTime::new(&config)));
19324        let now = global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos();
19325        for (raw, offset) in [(31, 10), (33, 20), (35, 30)] {
19326            let sleeper = DetTid::from_raw(raw);
19327            scheduler
19328                .blocked
19329                .timed_waiters
19330                .insert(now + LogicalTime::from_nanos(offset), sleeper);
19331            scheduler.priorities.insert(sleeper, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19332            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
19333                sleeper,
19334                ThreadNextTurn {
19335                    dettid: sleeper,
19336                    child_tid_addr: 0,
19337                    req: Ivar::new(),
19338                    resp: Ivar::new(),
19339                    protocol: Default::default(),
19340                },
19341            );
19342        }
19343        scheduler.committed_time = now + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_000);
19344        global_time
19345    }
19346
19347    fn fence_woken(scheduler: &Scheduler) -> Vec<i32> {
19348        [31, 33, 35]
19349            .into_iter()
19350            .filter(|raw| scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(DetTid::from_raw(*raw)))
19351            .collect()
19352    }
19353
19354    fn fence_finish(scheduler: &mut Scheduler, op_id: ExternalOpId) {
19355        let mut continuation = Resources::new(op_id.tid);
19356        continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(op_id), Permission::RW);
19357        scheduler.next_turns[&op_id.tid].req.put(Ok(continuation));
19358    }
19359
19360    /// Wait 3 passes, finish, then one pass per "turn"; report the turn at which each sleeper woke.
19361    fn fence_wake_turns(
19362        scheduler: &mut Scheduler,
19363        global_time: &Arc<Mutex<GlobalTime>>,
19364        op_id: ExternalOpId,
19365        _label: &str,
19366    ) -> (Vec<i32>, Vec<(i32, u64)>) {
19367        for _ in 0..3 {
19368            assert!(scheduler.step2_process_blocked(global_time).is_err());
19369        }
19370        let during_wait = fence_woken(scheduler);
19371        fence_finish(scheduler, op_id);
19372        let mut at = Vec::new();
19373        let mut seen: Vec<i32> = during_wait.clone();
19374        for raw in &during_wait {
19375            at.push((*raw, scheduler.turn));
19376        }
19377        for _ in 0..4 {
19378            let _ = scheduler.step2_process_blocked(global_time);
19379            for raw in fence_woken(scheduler) {
19380                if !seen.contains(&raw) {
19381                    seen.push(raw);
19382                    at.push((raw, scheduler.turn));
19383                }
19384            }
19385            // stand-in for step 3 committing a turn
19386            scheduler.turn += 1;
19387        }
19388        (during_wait, at)
19389    }

19391    /// With work runnable, replay waiting at a due vfork-child rejoin wakes no
19392    /// sleeper; once the call finishes, the three due sleepers wake one per
19393    /// turn, as in record (Claude re-check of
19394    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4298).
19395    #[test]
19396    fn replay_fires_due_timers_one_per_turn_around_a_runnable_branch_rejoin() {
19397        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(7);
19398        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(DetTid::from_raw(25), 4);
19399        let mut scheduler = rejoin_fixture(op_id, None, false);
19400        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(op_id.tid));
19401        fence_queue(&mut scheduler, DetTid::from_raw(9), false);
19402        let gt = fence_sleepers(&mut scheduler);
19403        replaying(
19404            &mut scheduler,
19405            &[Rejoin {
19406                turn: 12,
19407                wakes: 0,
19408                calls: vec![(op_id.tid, 4)],
19409            }],
19410        );
19411        scheduler.turn = 12;
19412        let (during, at) = fence_wake_turns(&mut scheduler, &gt, op_id, "runnable");
19413        assert!(during.is_empty());
19414        assert_eq!(at, vec![(31, 12), (33, 13), (35, 14)]);
19415    }

19532    /// Replay that reaches a due readmission before the call has finished
19533    /// pops no timed event while it waits, so the pass that readmits pops at
19534    /// most one, as record's single pass did (Claude review of
19535    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4298).
19536    #[test]
19537    fn replay_pops_no_timed_event_while_it_waits_at_a_due_rejoin() {
19538        let parent = DetTid::from_raw(7);
19539        let child = ExternalOpId::new(DetTid::from_raw(25), 4);
19540        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
19541        scheduler.recordreplay_modes = true;
19542        scheduler.vfork_barriers.insert(parent, Some(child.tid));
19543        background(&mut scheduler, child, false);
19544        queue_worker(&mut scheduler, DetTid::from_raw(9));
19545        let config = Config::default();
19546        let global_time = Arc::new(Mutex::new(GlobalTime::new(&config)));
19547        let now = global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos();
19548        let sleepers = [31, 33, 35].map(DetTid::from_raw);
19549        for (sleeper, offset) in sleepers.iter().zip([10, 20, 30]) {
19550            scheduler
19551                .blocked
19552                .timed_waiters
19553                .insert(now + LogicalTime::from_nanos(offset), *sleeper);
19554            scheduler.priorities.insert(*sleeper, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19555            scheduler.next_turns.insert(
19556                *sleeper,
19557                ThreadNextTurn {
19558                    dettid: *sleeper,
19559                    child_tid_addr: 0,
19560                    req: Ivar::new(),
19561                    resp: Ivar::new(),
19562                    protocol: Default::default(),
19563                },
19564            );
19565        }
19566        scheduler.committed_time = now + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_000);
19567        replaying(
19568            &mut scheduler,
19569            &[Rejoin {
19570                turn: 12,
19571                wakes: 0,
19572                calls: vec![(child.tid, 4)],
19573            }],
19574        );
19575        scheduler.turn = 12;
19576        let woken = |scheduler: &Scheduler| {
19577            sleepers
19578                .iter()
19579                .filter(|sleeper| scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(**sleeper))
19580                .count()
19581        };
19582
19583        for _ in 0..3 {
19584            assert!(scheduler.step2_process_blocked(&global_time).is_err());
19585        }
19586        assert_eq!(woken(&scheduler), 0, "a waiting pass popped a timed event");
19587        assert!(
19588            scheduler
19589                .blocked
19590                .external_io_blockers
19591                .contains_key(&child.tid)
19592        );
19593
19594        let mut continuation = Resources::new(child.tid);
19595        continuation.insert(ResourceID::BlockedExternalContinue(child), Permission::RW);
19596        scheduler.next_turns[&child.tid].req.put(Ok(continuation));
19597        let _ = scheduler.step2_process_blocked(&global_time);
19598        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(child.tid));
19599        assert!(
19600            woken(&scheduler) <= 1,
19601            "the readmitting pass popped more than one"
19602        );
19603        assert_eq!(scheduler.turn, 12);
19604    }

19677            (

19679                (13, 0),
19680                vec![Rejoin {
19681                    turn: 12,
19682                    wakes: 0,
19683                    calls: vec![(op_id.tid, 9)],
19684                }],

19686            (
19687                "passed by a wake",
19688                (12, 1),
19689                vec![Rejoin {
19690                    turn: 12,
19691                    wakes: 0,
19692                    calls: vec![(op_id.tid, 9)],
19693                }],

19701                    calls: vec![(op_id.tid, 8)],

19746    /// `scheduler` with `tid` queued for a turn, its request already posted.
19747    fn queue_request(scheduler: &mut Scheduler, tid: DetTid, request: Resources) {
19748        let req = Ivar::new();
19749        req.put(Ok(request));
19750        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
19751            tid,
19752            ThreadNextTurn {
19753                dettid: tid,
19754                child_tid_addr: 0,
19755                req,
19756                resp: Ivar::new(),
19757                protocol: Default::default(),
19758            },
19759        );
19760        scheduler.run_queue.push_back(tid, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19761    }
19762
19763    fn sleep_request(tid: DetTid, deadline: LogicalTime) -> Resources {
19764        let mut request = Resources::new(tid);
19765        request.insert(ResourceID::SleepUntil(deadline), Permission::W);
19766        request
19767    }

19769    const NOW_NS: u64 = 5_000_000;
19770
19771    fn hint(scheduler: &Scheduler, granted: DetTid) -> Option<Duration> {
19772        scheduler.deadline_remaining_from(granted, scheduler.committed_time)
19773    }
19774
19775    fn at(offset_ns: u64) -> LogicalTime {
19776        LogicalTime::from_nanos(NOW_NS + offset_ns)
19777    }

19779    /// The deadline hint of hermit#4121 is the time from `committed_time` to

19781    #[test]
19782    fn a_grant_hints_the_earliest_pending_deadline_from_every_source() {

19787
19788        scheduler
19789            .blocked
19790            .timed_waiters
19791            .insert(at(9_000), DetTid::from_raw(5));
19792        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), Some(Duration::from_nanos(9_000)));
19793
19794        let sleeper = DetTid::from_raw(7);
19795        queue_request(&mut scheduler, sleeper, sleep_request(sleeper, at(7_000)));
19796        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), Some(Duration::from_nanos(7_000)));
19797
19798        let poller = DetTid::from_raw(9);
19799        let mut poll = Resources::new(poller);
19800        poll.insert(ResourceID::InternalIOPolling, Permission::W);
19801        poll.poll_deadline = Some(at(6_000));
19802        queue_request(&mut scheduler, poller, poll);
19803        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), Some(Duration::from_nanos(6_000)));
19804
19805        scheduler
19806            .poll_deadlines
19807            .insert((at(5_000), DetTid::from_raw(11)));
19808        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), Some(Duration::from_nanos(5_000)));
19809    }

19811    /// A queued request whose deadline has passed, including a yield's
19812    /// `SleepUntil(0)`, is merely runnable and hints nothing; neither does a
19813    /// wait with no deadline, nor the granted thread's own request.
19814    #[test]
19815    fn passed_indefinite_and_own_deadlines_are_no_hint() {
19816        let granted = DetTid::from_raw(3);
19817        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
19818        scheduler.committed_time = at(0);
19819
19820        let yielder = DetTid::from_raw(5);
19821        queue_request(
19822            &mut scheduler,
19823            yielder,
19824            sleep_request(yielder, LogicalTime::from_nanos(0)),
19825        );
19826        let pause = DetTid::from_raw(9);
19827        queue_request(
19828            &mut scheduler,
19829            pause,
19830            sleep_request(pause, LogicalTime::INDEFINITE),
19831        );
19832        scheduler
19833            .blocked
19834            .timed_waiters
19835            .insert(LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, DetTid::from_raw(11));
19836        queue_request(&mut scheduler, granted, sleep_request(granted, at(1_000)));
19837        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), None);
19838
19839        // A queued sleep whose deadline has passed is simply runnable.
19840        let due = DetTid::from_raw(7);
19841        queue_request(&mut scheduler, due, sleep_request(due, at(0)));
19842        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), None);
19843
19844        // An entry kept past its time hints nothing: a backed-off poller's
19845        // deadline a suspended poller still holds, or a due timer. Hinting
19846        // zero for one would end every grant's slice early.
19847        scheduler
19848            .poll_deadlines
19849            .insert((at(0), DetTid::from_raw(13)));
19850        scheduler
19851            .blocked
19852            .timed_waiters
19853            .insert(at(0), DetTid::from_raw(15));
19854        assert_eq!(hint(&scheduler, granted), None);
19855    }

19876            .thread_tree

19963    /// `scheduler` with `sleeper` asleep until 1 µs from now; returns the clock
19964    /// and the deadline.
19965    fn add_sleeper(
19966        scheduler: &mut Scheduler,
19967        sleeper: DetTid,
19968    ) -> (Arc<Mutex<GlobalTime>>, LogicalTime) {
19969        let config = Config::default();
19970        let global_time = Arc::new(Mutex::new(GlobalTime::new(&config)));
19971        let deadline = global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos() + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1_000);
19972        scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.insert(deadline, sleeper);
19973        scheduler.priorities.insert(sleeper, DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
19974        scheduler.next_turns.insert(
19975            sleeper,
19976            ThreadNextTurn {
19977                dettid: sleeper,
19978                child_tid_addr: 0,
19979                req: Ivar::new(),
19980                resp: Ivar::new(),
19981                protocol: Default::default(),
19982            },
19983        );
19984        (global_time, deadline)
19985    }

19987    /// With a backgrounded call unfinished and nothing queued, record wakes a
19988    /// thread sleeping in virtual time instead of spinning: the call may wait
19989    /// on that thread (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3881).
19990    #[test]
19991    fn record_wakes_a_sleeper_while_a_backgrounded_call_runs() {
19992        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(DetTid::from_raw(21), 9);
19993        let sleeper = DetTid::from_raw(5);
19994        let mut scheduler = rejoin_fixture(op_id, None, false);
19995        let (global_time, deadline) = add_sleeper(&mut scheduler, sleeper);
19996
19997        assert!(scheduler.step2_process_blocked(&global_time).is_err());
19998        assert_eq!(global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), deadline);
19999        assert_eq!(scheduler.empty_queue_wakes, 1);
20000        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(sleeper));
20001        assert_eq!(
20002            scheduler.blocked.external_io_blockers.get(&op_id.tid),
20003            Some(&op_id)
20004        );
20005    }

20007    /// Replay readmits a finished call at its logged turn and wake count. At
20008    /// an earlier wake count in that turn it wakes the sleeper as record did,
20009    /// leaving the call parked; at the logged point it readmits the call
20010    /// without waking anyone.
20011    #[test]
20012    fn replay_follows_the_wake_count_within_a_turn() {
20013        let op_id = ExternalOpId::new(DetTid::from_raw(21), 9);
20014        let sleeper = DetTid::from_raw(5);
20015        let logged = Rejoin {
20016            turn: 12,
20017            wakes: 1,
20018            calls: vec![(op_id.tid, 9)],
20019        };
20020
20021        let mut early = rejoin_fixture(op_id, None, true);
20022        let (global_time, deadline) = add_sleeper(&mut early, sleeper);
20023        replaying(&mut early, std::slice::from_ref(&logged));
20024        early.turn = 12;
20025        assert!(early.step2_process_blocked(&global_time).is_err());
20026        assert!(early.rejoin_refusal.is_none());
20027        assert_eq!(global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos(), deadline);
20028        assert_eq!(early.empty_queue_wakes, 1);
20029        assert_eq!(
20030            early.blocked.external_io_blockers.get(&op_id.tid),
20031            Some(&op_id)
20032        );
20033
20034        let mut due = rejoin_fixture(op_id, None, true);
20035        let (global_time, deadline) = add_sleeper(&mut due, sleeper);
20036        replaying(&mut due, std::slice::from_ref(&logged));
20037        due.turn = 12;
20038        due.empty_queue_wakes = 1;
20039        assert!(due.step2_process_blocked(&global_time).is_ok());
20040        assert!(due.rejoin_refusal.is_none());
20041        assert!(global_time.lock().unwrap().as_nanos() < deadline);
20042        assert!(due.blocked.external_io_blockers.is_empty());
20043        assert!(due.run_queue.contains_tid(op_id.tid));
20044    }

20175    /// A cross-task signal must interrupt a precise-mode futex waiter, which sleeps
20176    /// outside the run queue (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3146).
20177    #[test]
20178    fn pending_signal_interrupts_a_parked_futex_waiter() {
20179        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
20180        let target = DetTid::from_raw(100);
20181        register_known_thread(&mut scheduler, target);
20182        let futex = FutexID::private(MmId::initial(DetPid::from_raw(100)), 0x404110);
20183        scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(
20184            &target,
20185            futex,
20186            None,
20187            u32::MAX,
20188            Some(signal_watch(usr_signals())),
20189        );
20190        scheduler
20191            .test_kernel_signal_states
20192            .insert(target, signal_state(usr_signals(), 0));
20193        assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20194        assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20195
20196        scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR2));
20197        scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR1));
20198        // Nothing moves until the deterministic step2 drain.
20199        assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20200        assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20201        scheduler.drain_pending_cross_task_signals();
20202
20203        assert!(scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.is_empty());
20204        assert!(!scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20205        assert!(scheduler.blocked.no_futex_waiters());
20206        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20207        assert_eq!(
20208            scheduler.inbound_signals(target),
20209            vec![
20210                SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR1),
20211                SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR2)
20212            ]
20213        );
20214        // A futex wake that arrives afterwards finds no waiter to take.
20215        assert_eq!(scheduler.wake_futex_waiters(target, futex, 1, u32::MAX), 0);
20216    }
20217
20218    fn usr_signals() -> u64 {
20219        kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1) | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR2)
20220    }

20222    /// A precise-mode futex waiter's report in a unit test. The `/proc` identity
20223    /// names no live thread, so a test that installs no kernel signal state for
20224    /// the waiter exercises the read-error fallback.
20225    fn signal_watch(unblocked: u64) -> FutexSignalWatch {
20226        FutexSignalWatch {
20227            unblocked,
20228            defers_default_stops: false,
20229            pid: i32::MAX,
20230            tid: i32::MAX,
20231        }
20232    }
20233
20234    /// Kernel dispositions with `caught` handled and `ignored` set to `SIG_IGN`;
20235    /// every other signal keeps its default action.
20236    fn signal_state(caught: u64, ignored: u64) -> KernelSignalState {
20237        KernelSignalState {
20238            caught,
20239            ignored,
20240            ..Default::default()
20241        }
20242    }

20244    fn parked_futex_target(scheduler: &mut Scheduler) -> (DetTid, FutexID) {
20245        let target = DetTid::from_raw(100);
20246        register_known_thread(scheduler, target);
20247        (
20248            target,
20249            FutexID::private(MmId::initial(DetPid::from_raw(100)), 0x404110),
20250        )
20251    }

20253    /// A cross-task signal the waiter blocks, ignores, or ignores by default leaves
20254    /// a precise-mode futex waiter parked with its original deadline, alongside one
20255    /// that does interrupt it (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3146).
20256    #[test]
20257    fn non_interrupting_signal_leaves_a_parked_futex_waiter_parked() {
20258        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
20259        let (target, futex) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20260        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(300_000_000);
20261        // SIGTERM is blocked. SIGUSR1 is caught, SIGUSR2 is ignored, and SIGWINCH
20262        // and SIGCHLD keep their default action, which ignores them.
20263        let unblocked =
20264            usr_signals() | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGWINCH) | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGCHLD);
20265        scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(
20266            &target,
20267            futex,
20268            Some(deadline),
20269            u32::MAX,
20270            Some(signal_watch(unblocked)),
20271        );
20272        scheduler.test_kernel_signal_states.insert(
20273            target,
20274            signal_state(
20275                kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1),
20276                kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR2),
20277            ),
20278        );
20279
20280        scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR2));
20281        scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGWINCH));
20282        scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGTERM));
20283        scheduler.drain_pending_cross_task_signals();
20284        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGUSR2);
20285        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGCHLD);
20286        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGTERM);
20287
20288        assert!(scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.is_empty());
20289        assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20290        assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20291        assert!(scheduler.inbound_signals(target).is_empty());
20292        assert_eq!(
20293            scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
20294            vec![(deadline, TimedEvent::ThreadEvt(target))]
20295        );
20296
20297        // The one signal that interrupts the wait still ends it.
20298        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGUSR1);
20299        assert!(!scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20300        assert!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20301        assert!(scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.is_empty());
20302        assert_eq!(
20303            scheduler.inbound_signals(target),
20304            vec![SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR1)]
20305        );
20306    }

20308    /// A timed `FUTEX_WAIT`, whose restart would start its relative timeout again,
20309    /// stays parked with its original deadline when a default `SIGTSTP` arrives:
20310    /// Linux discards that stop in an orphaned process group and the wait goes on.
20311    /// `SIGSTOP` and a caught `SIGTSTP` still end it, and a wait that does not
20312    /// defer default stops is ended by the default `SIGTSTP` too (review of
20313    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361 at `cbb36408`, finding 4).
20314    #[test]
20315    fn a_default_job_control_stop_leaves_a_rearming_futex_wait_parked() {
20316        let stops = kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTSTP)
20317            | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTTIN)
20318            | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTTOU);
20319        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(300_000_000);
20320        let park = |scheduler: &mut Scheduler, defers_default_stops: bool, caught: u64| {
20321            let (target, futex) = parked_futex_target(scheduler);
20322            scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(
20323                &target,
20324                futex,
20325                Some(deadline),
20326                u32::MAX,
20327                Some(FutexSignalWatch {
20328                    defers_default_stops,
20329                    ..signal_watch(stops | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGSTOP))
20330                }),
20331            );
20332            scheduler
20333                .test_kernel_signal_states
20334                .insert(target, signal_state(caught, 0));
20335            target
20336        };
20337        let assert_parked = |scheduler: &Scheduler, target: DetTid| {
20338            assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20339            assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20340            assert!(scheduler.inbound_signals(target).is_empty());
20341            assert_eq!(
20342                scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
20343                vec![(deadline, TimedEvent::ThreadEvt(target))]
20344            );
20345        };
20346        let assert_woken = |scheduler: &Scheduler, target: DetTid, signal: Signal| {
20347            assert!(!scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20348            assert!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20349            assert!(scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.is_empty());
20350            assert_eq!(
20351                scheduler.inbound_signals(target),
20352                vec![SigWrapper::from(signal)]
20353            );
20354        };
20355
20356        // Through the drain of cross-task signals and through scheduler sends.
20357        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
20358        let target = park(&mut scheduler, true, 0);
20359        for signal in [Signal::SIGTSTP, Signal::SIGTTIN, Signal::SIGTTOU] {
20360            scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(signal));
20361        }
20362        scheduler.drain_pending_cross_task_signals();
20363        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGTSTP);
20364        assert!(scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.is_empty());
20365        assert_parked(&scheduler, target);
20366        // SIGSTOP always stops the process, so it still ends the wait.
20367        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGSTOP);
20368        assert_woken(&scheduler, target, Signal::SIGSTOP);
20369
20370        // A handler makes SIGTSTP an ordinary caught signal.
20371        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
20372        let target = park(&mut scheduler, true, kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTSTP));
20373        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGTSTP);
20374        assert_woken(&scheduler, target, Signal::SIGTSTP);
20375
20376        // A wait whose restart keeps its deadline takes the default stop at once.
20377        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config::default());
20378        let target = park(&mut scheduler, false, 0);
20379        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGTSTP);
20380        assert_woken(&scheduler, target, Signal::SIGTSTP);
20381    }
20382
20383    /// A precise-mode futex waiter is admitted on its mask and on what Linux
20384    /// does with the signal as it is sent: a blocked one is not recorded
20385    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3146), and neither is one that
20386    /// is ignored now, which Linux discards at generation, so a handler
20387    /// installed before the drain does not bring it back (the Claude review of
20388    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4290; before it, an ignored
20389    /// signal was recorded and the drain decided from the dispositions then).
20390    /// The drain still decides from the dispositions it reads for a signal it
20391    /// did record (`a_signal_caught_after_a_futex_wait_began_ends_it`).
20392    ///
20393    /// The sender records each send's fate in its turn, before it notifies
20394    /// (`discarded_at_send`, <https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4293>),
20395    /// and the admission reads that record.
20396    #[test]
20397    fn a_parked_futex_waiter_is_admitted_on_its_mask_and_the_disposition_at_the_send() {
20398        let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20399        let (target, futex) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20400        scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(
20401            &target,
20402            futex,
20403            None,
20404            u32::MAX,
20405            Some(signal_watch(
20406                kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1) | kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTERM),
20407            )),
20408        );
20409        // SIGUSR1 ignored, SIGTERM caught; SIGUSR2 blocked by the wait's mask.
20410        scheduler.test_kernel_signal_states.insert(
20411            target,
20412            signal_state(
20413                kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTERM),
20414                kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1),
20415            ),
20416        );
20417
20418        for signal in [Signal::SIGUSR1, Signal::SIGUSR2, Signal::SIGTERM] {
20419            record_guest_send(&mut scheduler, target, signal as i32);
20420            scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(signal));
20421        }
20422
20423        assert_eq!(
20424            scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.get(&target),
20425            Some(&vec![SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGTERM)])
20426        );
20427        assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20428    }
20429
20430    /// C1 of the Claude approval of the design of
20431    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4293: a scheduler send Linux
20432    /// discards commits nothing to a parked futex waiter, whatever that
20433    /// branch's own filter says. SIGUSR1 at its default action to a PID
20434    /// namespace's init is discarded (`SIGNAL_UNKILLABLE`), which
20435    /// `parked_futex_interrupting_signals` does not model: it calls SIGUSR1
20436    /// interrupting.
20437    #[test]
20438    fn a_discarded_scheduler_send_to_a_namespace_init_commits_no_futex_wake() {
20439        let usr1 = kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
20440        let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20441        let (target, futex) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20442        scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(&target, futex, None, u32::MAX, Some(signal_watch(usr1)));
20443        scheduler
20444            .test_kernel_signal_states
20445            .insert(target, signal_state(0, 0));
20446        assert!(!scheduler.discarded_when_sent_to(target, libc::SIGUSR1, None));
20447        scheduler
20448            .thread_tree
20449            .mark_pid_namespace_init(DetPid::from_raw(target.as_raw()));
20450        assert!(scheduler.discarded_when_sent_to(target, libc::SIGUSR1, None));
20451        assert_eq!(
20452            scheduler
20453                .parked_futex_interrupting_signals(target, 0)
20454                .map(|signals| signals & usr1),
20455            Some(usr1),
20456            "the branch's own filter would wake it"
20457        );
20458        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest_as(target, Signal::SIGUSR1, true);
20459        assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target));
20460        assert!(scheduler.inbound_signals(target).is_empty());
20461    }

20463    /// R5-1 of the design review of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4293:
20464    /// a discarded scheduler send skips only the branches that commit an
20465    /// `InboundSignal`. The physical copy still wakes a thread asleep in a real
20466    /// `rt_sigsuspend` whose mask admits it, so that thread is still armed for
20467    /// the release barrier, which fixes where its continuation rejoins.
20468    #[test]
20469    fn a_discarded_scheduler_send_still_arms_a_thread_asleep_outside_the_schedule() {
20470        let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20471        let (target, _) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20472        let op = ExternalOpId {
20473            tid: target,
20474            sequence: 1,
20475        };
20476        scheduler.blocked.rt_sigsuspend_blockers.insert(target, op);
20477        scheduler
20478            .blocked
20479            .out_of_scheduler_masks
20480            .insert(target, Some(0));
20481        scheduler.wake_signaled_guest_as(target, Signal::SIGUSR1, true);
20482        assert!(scheduler.blocked.signaled_background.contains(&target));
20483    }

20485    /// A discarded scheduler send commits no `InboundSignal` to a parked
20486    /// sleep (R4-1 of the design review of
20487    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4293): the sleep stays parked,
20488    /// where a kept send of the same signal wakes it.
20489    #[test]
20490    fn a_discarded_scheduler_send_leaves_a_parked_sleep_parked() {
20491        for discarded in [true, false] {
20492            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20493            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI, false);
20494            scheduler.wake_signaled_guest_as(target, Signal::SIGUSR1, discarded);
20495            if discarded {
20496                assert!(scheduler.inbound_signals(target).is_empty());
20497                assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
20498            } else {
20499                assert_eq!(
20500                    scheduler.inbound_signals(target),
20501                    vec![SigWrapper::from(Signal::SIGUSR1)]
20502                );
20503            }
20504        }
20505    }

20507    /// The mask that decides a discard is the first source present: the
20508    /// guest's own mask while Detcore holds a private one, a parked futex
20509    /// waiter's watch, the mask recorded for a thread asleep outside the
20510    /// schedule (an unknown one decides nothing), then `SigBlk`. A task the
20511    /// scheduler does not know, such as an exited leader whose frozen mask
20512    /// Detcore never read, is not discarded
20513    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4293).
20514    #[test]
20515    fn the_discard_mask_takes_the_first_source_present() {
20516        let usr1 = kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
20517        let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20518        let (target, futex) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20519        let mut state = signal_state(0, usr1);
20520        state.blocked = usr1;
20521        scheduler.test_kernel_signal_states.insert(target, state);
20522        let discarded =
20523            |scheduler: &Scheduler| scheduler.discarded_when_sent_to(target, libc::SIGUSR1, None);
20524        assert!(!discarded(&scheduler), "SigBlk blocks it");
20525        // A filed rt_sigsuspend's temporary mask decides before SigBlk.
20526        let mut request = Resources::new(target);
20527        request.insert(
20528            ResourceID::BlockingRtSigsuspend(ExternalOpId::new(target, 1)),
20529            Permission::RW,
20530        );
20531        request.blocked_signal_mask = Some(0);
20532        scheduler.next_turns.get_mut(&target).unwrap().req = Ivar::full(Ok(request));
20533        assert!(
20534            discarded(&scheduler),
20535            "the filed rt_sigsuspend's mask before SigBlk"
20536        );
20537        scheduler
20538            .blocked
20539            .out_of_scheduler_masks
20540            .insert(target, Some(usr1));
20541        assert!(
20542            !discarded(&scheduler),
20543            "the sleeping mask before the filed rt_sigsuspend's"
20544        );
20545        scheduler
20546            .blocked
20547            .out_of_scheduler_masks
20548            .insert(target, Some(0));
20549        assert!(discarded(&scheduler), "the sleeping mask before SigBlk");
20550        scheduler
20551            .blocked
20552            .out_of_scheduler_masks
20553            .insert(target, None);
20554        assert!(!discarded(&scheduler), "an unknown sleeping mask");
20555        scheduler.blocked.out_of_scheduler_masks.remove(&target);
20556        scheduler.next_turns.get_mut(&target).unwrap().req = Ivar::new();
20557        scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(&target, futex, None, u32::MAX, Some(signal_watch(usr1)));
20558        assert!(discarded(&scheduler), "the futex watch before SigBlk");
20559        assert!(scheduler.set_saved_guest_sigmask(target, Some(usr1)));
20560        assert!(!discarded(&scheduler), "the guest's own mask first");
20561        assert!(!scheduler.discarded_when_sent_to(DetTid::from_raw(999), libc::SIGUSR1, None));
20562    }
20563
20564    /// A send of SIGCONT flushes the stop signals from every queue of the
20565    /// process, as `prepare_signal` does, so a discarded stop signal's bit
20566    /// goes with it (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4293).
20567    #[test]
20568    fn a_sigcont_send_flushes_a_discarded_stop_signal() {
20569        let tstp = kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGTSTP);
20570        let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20571        let (target, _) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20572        scheduler
20573            .test_kernel_signal_states
20574            .insert(target, signal_state(0, tstp));
20575        record_guest_send(&mut scheduler, target, libc::SIGTSTP);
20576        assert_eq!(scheduler.discarded_bits(target).0 & tstp, tstp);
20577        record_guest_send(&mut scheduler, target, libc::SIGCONT);
20578        assert_eq!(scheduler.discarded_bits(target).0 & tstp, 0);
20579    }
20580
20581    /// Record a guest's thread-directed send of `signal` to `target` in the
20582    /// discarded-at-send record, as its sender does in its turn
20583    /// (`DiscardedSignalControl::PreSend`, then `Sent`).
20584    fn record_guest_send(scheduler: &mut Scheduler, target: DetTid, signal: i32) {
20585        let queue = discarded_at_send::QueueId::Thread(target);
20586        let token = scheduler.discard_pre_send(target, queue, signal, Some(target));
20587        scheduler.discard_note_send(token, None, None);
20588    }
20589
20590    /// A signal ignored by default with no handler when it is sent (here a
20591    /// guest's recorded thread-directed SIGCHLD, and SIGURG) is discarded by
20592    /// Linux then. A handler installed before the drain, which `rt_sigaction`
20593    /// does without a turn, does not end the wait: it stays parked
20594    /// (the Claude review of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/4290).
20595    #[test]
20596    fn a_signal_discarded_when_sent_does_not_end_a_futex_wait_a_later_handler_could() {
20597        use child_exit_sigchld::ChildExitSigchldControl;
20598        for signal in [Signal::SIGCHLD, Signal::SIGURG] {
20599            let bit = kernel_signal_bit(signal as libc::c_int);
20600            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
20601            let (target, futex) = parked_futex_target(&mut scheduler);
20602            scheduler.sleep_futex_waiter(&target, futex, None, u32::MAX, Some(signal_watch(bit)));
20603            scheduler
20604                .test_kernel_signal_states
20605                .insert(target, signal_state(0, 0));
20606            if signal == Signal::SIGCHLD {
20607                scheduler.child_exit_sigchld_control(
20608                    target,
20609                    ChildExitSigchldControl::PrivateSent { target },
20610                );
20611            }
20612            // The sender records the send's fate in its turn.
20613            record_guest_send(&mut scheduler, target, signal as libc::c_int);
20614            scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper::from(signal));
20615            // The handler arrives after the send, before the drain.
20616            scheduler
20617                .test_kernel_signal_states
20618                .insert(target, signal_state(bit, 0));
20619            scheduler.drain_pending_cross_task_signals();
20620            assert!(scheduler.is_parked_futex_waiter(target), "{signal}");
20621            assert!(scheduler.inbound_signals(target).is_empty(), "{signal}");
20622        }
20623    }
